title: 钩线机构
The Hook Mechanism
goals: 能解释工业平缝机为什么采用全回转旋梭、为什么旋梭与主轴的转速比是 2:1，并能算出梭尖线速度。
Explain why industrial lockstitch machines use the full rotary hook and why the hook-to-shaft speed ratio is 2:1, and calculate the linear speed of the hook point.
能用第 3 章的近似式 h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ² 在回升量和主轴转角之间换算，并算出调钩线时刻时旋梭要在轴上转过的角度。
Convert between needle rise and main-shaft angle with the Chapter 3 approximation h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ², and calculate how far the hook must be turned on its shaft to change the loop-catch timing.
能算出换针号以后梭尖间隙的变化，并判断是否需要重调。
Calculate how the hook-to-needle clearance changes after a needle-size change and judge whether it must be re-set.
能读懂钩线窗口图，说明钩线时刻、针杆高度、梭尖间隙三个量为什么要联调，以及针织物为什么更容易跳针。
Read the loop-catch window chart and explain why loop-catch timing, needle-bar height and clearance must be adjusted together, and why knits skip stitches more readily.
能在虚拟实验中按“时刻 → 高度 → 间隙”的顺序把一台没调好的机器调好。
Set a badly adjusted machine right in the virtual lab, following the order timing → height → clearance.

title: 换了粗针，旋梭处“嗒嗒”响
A thicker needle, and a clicking at the hook
text: 某服装厂把一条衬衫线改做牛仔裤。修机师傅把机针从 Nm 90（直径 0.9 mm）换成 Nm 110（直径 1.1 mm），旋梭没有动。原来缝衬衫时梭尖间隙调在 0.06 mm，钩线时刻按机针回升 2.0 mm 设定（算例机：曲柄半径 r = 15.5 mm，连杆比 λ = 0.282）。开机后旋梭处传来“嗒嗒”的金属声，几百针以后机针折断。车间主任还想按手册把牛仔料的钩线时刻调到回升 2.5 mm。

A garment factory switches a shirt line to jeans. The mechanic changes the needle from Nm 90 (diameter 0.9 mm) to Nm 110 (diameter 1.1 mm) without touching the hook. For shirts the hook clearance had been set to 0.06 mm and the loop-catch timing to a needle rise of 2.0 mm (worked-example machine: crank radius r = 15.5 mm, link ratio λ = 0.282). When the machine starts there is a metallic clicking at the hook, and after a few hundred stitches the needle snaps. The supervisor also wants to set the loop-catch timing for denim to a rise of 2.5 mm, as the manual suggests for heavy material.
question: 换针以后梭尖间隙变成多少？要把旋梭沿轴向移动多少才能回到 0.06 mm？把回升量从 2.0 mm 改到 2.5 mm，钩线的主轴转角从多少变到多少，旋梭要在轴上转过多少度？

What does the hook clearance become after the needle change? How far must the hook be moved along its axis to return to 0.06 mm? If the needle rise is changed from 2.0 mm to 2.5 mm, how does the main-shaft angle of loop catch change, and through how many degrees must the hook be turned on its shaft?
answer: 粗针表面向梭尖靠近半个直径差 (1.1 − 0.9)/2 = 0.10 mm，间隙变为 0.06 − 0.10 = −0.04 mm，梭尖撞针，这就是响声和断针的原因；要把旋梭沿轴向向外移 0.10 mm，间隙回到 0.06 mm（手册范围 0.04–0.1 mm）。按 h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ²，回升 2.0 mm 对应约 205.7°（精确计算 206.1°），2.5 mm 对应约 208.7°，主轴差约 3.0°；旋梭转速是主轴的两倍，所以旋梭在轴上要转约 6°。调完时刻还要复查针杆高度，最后再调间隙。

The thicker needle’s surface moves towards the hook point by half the diameter difference, (1.1 − 0.9)/2 = 0.10 mm, so the clearance becomes 0.06 − 0.10 = −0.04 mm: the hook point strikes the needle, which explains the clicking and the broken needle. The hook must be moved 0.10 mm outward along its axis to restore 0.06 mm (manual range 0.04–0.1 mm). From h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ², a 2.0 mm rise corresponds to about 205.7° (206.1° exactly) and 2.5 mm to about 208.7°, a difference of about 3.0° of main-shaft angle; since the hook turns twice as fast as the main shaft, it must be turned about 6° on its shaft. After the timing, check the needle-bar height, and set the clearance last.

title: 钩线窗口 ↔ 机器人在传送带上抓取运动的工件
Loop-catch window ↔ a robot picking a moving part from a conveyor
text: 梭尖钩线和机器人在运动的传送带上抓件是同一类问题：执行器必须在正确的时刻、正确的高度、留着正确的间隙到达一个正在运动的目标。平缝机靠机械传动把旋梭“锁”在主轴相位上；机器人则用传送带编码器做“主轴”，按编码器读数实时修正抓取点，这叫传送带跟踪，本质上是电子凸轮。钩线窗口在 5000 r/min 下只有约 0.27 ms，所以必须靠刚性的 2:1 传动；机器人抓件的时间窗口宽得多，但夹爪开口与工件之间的间隙同样决定成败。换粗针要重调梭尖间隙，对应机器人换夹爪或换工具后必须重新标定工具中心点（TCP），否则夹爪会撞上工件。

Catching the loop with the hook point and a robot picking a part from a moving conveyor are the same kind of problem: the end effector must reach a moving target at the right instant, at the right height and with the right clearance. The lockstitch machine locks the hook to the main-shaft phase mechanically; a robot uses the conveyor encoder as its “main shaft” and corrects the pick point in real time from the encoder reading, which is called conveyor tracking and is essentially an electronic cam. At 5000 r/min the loop-catch window is only about 0.27 ms, which is why a rigid 2:1 drive is needed; the robot’s time window is much wider, but the clearance between gripper jaws and part decides success just as much. Re-setting the hook clearance after fitting a thicker needle corresponds to re-calibrating the tool centre point (TCP) after a robot changes its gripper or tool; otherwise the gripper crashes into the part.

title: 接力赛交接棒
Passing the baton in a relay
text: 接力赛交接棒也有一个“窗口”：接棒人起跑早了，交棒人追不上；起跑晚了，两人撞在一起；手伸得高低不对，棒就掉了。时刻、高度、距离三者要一起配合，这和梭尖钩线一模一样。

Passing the baton in a relay race also has a “window”: if the receiver starts too early, the passer cannot catch up; too late and they collide; hold the hand at the wrong height and the baton drops. Timing, height and distance must work together — exactly like the hook point catching the loop.

title: 引子：跳针
Opening: skipped stitches
points: 跳针：一针中面线和底线没有交织，面线在布面拉成长线。
Skipped stitch: at one stitch the needle and bobbin threads fail to interlace; the needle thread lies in a long span on top.
原因很多：针织面料、换针号、机针钝或装歪、针线不匹配。
Many causes: knit fabrics, a needle-size change, a blunt or crooked needle, mismatched needle and thread.
修机师傅最常查三件事：梭尖什么时候到、在什么高度到、离机针多近。
Mechanics check three things most: when the hook point arrives, at what height, and how close to the needle.
相伴的毛病：梭尖太近刮针、撞针；太贴近针眼劈线、断线。
Related faults: a hook too close scrapes or strikes the needle; too close to the eye splits or cuts the thread.
narration: 同学们先看车间里最常见的一个毛病：跳针。缝着缝着，线迹中间突然少了一针，面线在布面上拉成一条长线，两根线在这一针没有交织。轻的难看，重的一拉就开。原因很多，换了针织面料、换了针号、机针钝了或者装歪了，都可能跳针。但老师傅最先查的，永远是旋梭和机针之间的三个关系：梭尖什么时候到、在什么高度到、离机针有多近。今天这一讲，就是把这三个关系讲透，最后让大家在虚拟实验里亲手把一台没调好的机器调好。

Let’s start with the most common fault on the shop floor: skipped stitches. Partway along a seam a stitch is suddenly missing, the needle thread lies across the top in a long span, and the two threads do not interlace at that stitch. In mild cases it looks bad; in bad ones the seam opens when pulled. There are many causes — a knit fabric, a different needle size, a blunt or crooked needle. But what an experienced mechanic checks first is always three relationships between hook and needle: when the hook point arrives, at what height, and how close to the needle. Today we work through these three, and at the end you will set a badly adjusted machine right yourself in the virtual lab.

title: 钩线机构的四项任务
The four tasks of the hook mechanism
points: 钩住：机针回升，线环在凹口一侧鼓出，梭尖从机针和线环之间钻过去。
Catch: as the needle rises, the loop bulges on the scarf side and the hook point passes between needle and loop.
拉大、绕过梭壳：梭尖带着线环转，底线穿进线环。
Enlarge and pass round the bobbin case: the hook carries the loop round and the bobbin thread passes through it.
脱环：线环从梭壳滑出，挑线杆收紧。
Cast off: the loop slides off the bobbin case and the take-up lever pulls it tight.
第 4 章算例：206° 钩线，约 296° 线环最大，约 341° 脱环，梭尖转约 270°。
Chapter 4 example: catch at 206°, loop largest at about 296°, cast-off at about 341°; the hook point turns about 270°.
narration: 钩线机构在一针里要做四件事。第一是钩住：机针从最低点回升的时候，面线在凹口一侧鼓出一个线环，梭尖要正好从机针和线环之间钻过去。第二是拉大，第三是带着线环绕过装底线的梭壳，这样底线就穿进了线环。第四是脱环，线环从梭壳上滑下来，挑线杆把它收紧。第 4 章算过，钩线在主轴 206°，脱环在 341° 左右，这一段梭尖转了大约 270°。后三件事靠旋梭的形状和挑线配合，设计定了就很少要调；第一件钩住，对位置和时刻极其敏感，是本讲的重点。

Within one stitch the hook mechanism has four jobs. First, catch: as the needle rises from its lowest point, the needle thread bulges into a loop on the scarf side, and the hook point must pass exactly between needle and loop. Second, enlarge it; third, carry the loop round the bobbin case so the bobbin thread passes through it. Fourth, cast off: the loop slides off the case and the take-up lever pulls it tight. Chapter 4 found catch at 206° of the main shaft and cast-off at about 341°, during which the hook point turns about 270°. The last three jobs depend on the hook’s shape and the take-up, and rarely need adjusting once the design is fixed. The first, catching, is extremely sensitive to position and timing, and it is the focus of this lesson.

title: 三种钩线器
Three loop-catching devices
points: 摆梭：梭子连梭芯一起在弧形梭床里来回摆，质量大、每针两次换向，转速上不去。
Oscillating shuttle: shuttle and bobbin swing together in a curved race; heavy, two reversals per stitch, so speed stays low.
半回转旋梭：绕轴来回转动，每针一个来回，仍用于许多家用机。
Half rotary hook: turns back and forth about an axis, one round trip per stitch; still used in many domestic machines.
全回转旋梭：连续单向旋转，梭壳由定位钩挡住不转；无换向冲击，工业平缝机普遍采用。
Full rotary hook: rotates continuously in one direction, the bobbin case held by a positioning finger; no reversal impact, so industrial machines use it.
水平轴（工业平缝机多用）与竖直轴（家用机、部分厚料机）；厚料还有大旋梭。
Horizontal axis (most industrial machines) and vertical axis (domestic and some heavy-duty machines); jumbo hooks for heavy work.
narration: 钩线器按运动方式分三类，大家看图。最早的是摆梭，梭子带着梭芯在一条弧形梭床里来回摆，质量大，而且每针要换向两次，速度提不上去。半回转旋梭轻巧一些，旋梭体绕轴来回转，现在很多家用机还在用。工业平缝机几乎都用全回转旋梭：旋梭体一直朝一个方向转，装底线的梭壳被定位钩挡住不动，没有换向冲击，所以能跑很高的速度。全回转旋梭又分水平轴和竖直轴，工业平缝机多是水平轴，梭壳从前面装卸。这里有一个固有矛盾：底线要整个穿过线环，所以梭芯要小，或者挑线行程要长，这就是第 4 章一针要放近八十毫米线的原因。

Loop-catching devices fall into three classes by their motion — look at the figure. The earliest is the oscillating shuttle: the shuttle and bobbin swing together in a curved race. The mass is large and it reverses twice every stitch, so it cannot go fast. The half rotary hook is lighter; its body turns back and forth about an axis, and many domestic machines still use it. Industrial lockstitch machines almost all use the full rotary hook: the body keeps turning in one direction while the bobbin case is held still by a positioning finger, so there is no reversal impact and it can run very fast. Full rotary hooks have horizontal or vertical axes; industrial machines mostly use horizontal ones, with the case loaded from the front. There is an inherent dilemma: the bobbin thread must pass completely through the loop, so the bobbin must be small or the take-up stroke long — which is why Chapter 4 found nearly eighty millimetres of thread released per stitch.

title: 为什么旋梭转得比主轴快一倍
Why the hook turns twice as fast as the main shaft
points: 从钩住到脱环，旋梭要转约 270°。
From catch to cast-off the hook must turn about 270°.
2:1 时只占主轴 135°：206° 钩线、341° 脱环，到下一针入布（102°）还有一百多度收线、送布。
At 2:1 this takes only 135° of the shaft: catch 206°, cast-off 341°, leaving over 100° for take-up and feed before the next needle entry (102°).
1:1 时要占主轴 270°：脱环在 476°（下一针 116°），而下一针在 102° 已经入布。
At 1:1 it would take 270°: cast-off at 476° (116° of the next stitch), but the next needle has entered at 102°.
2:1 的代价：旋梭第二圈空转。
The price of 2:1: the hook’s second turn is idle.
narration: 为什么旋梭要转两圈配主轴一圈？看图 5-2。从钩住线环到线环脱出梭壳，旋梭大约要转 270°。传动比 2:1 时，这只占主轴 135°，206° 钩线，341° 就脱环了，离下一针针尖入布的 102° 还有一百多度，挑线杆有时间收紧线迹，送布牙也在这段时间送布。如果改成 1:1，旋梭转 270° 就要占主轴 270°，线环要到 476°，也就是下一针的 116° 才脱出，可下一针在 102° 就已经刺进布了，上一针还没收紧，下一针已经开始。所以全回转旋梭用一圈空转，换来足够的收线时间。

Why does the hook make two turns for each turn of the main shaft? Look at Fig. 5-2. From catching the loop to the loop leaving the bobbin case, the hook turns about 270°. At 2:1 that is only 135° of the main shaft: catch at 206°, cast-off at 341°, and there are still over a hundred degrees before the next needle point enters the fabric at 102°, so the take-up lever has time to set the stitch and the feed dog has time to feed. At 1:1 the 270° would take 270° of the main shaft, and the loop would not leave until 476°, which is 116° of the next stitch — but the next needle has already pierced the fabric at 102°. The previous stitch is not yet set and the next one has already begun. So the full rotary hook spends an idle turn to buy enough take-up time.

title: 梭尖有多快
How fast is the hook point?
points: 旋梭转速 = 2 × 主轴转速：主轴 5000 r/min 时旋梭 10000 r/min。
Hook speed = 2 × shaft speed: 10 000 r/min at a shaft speed of 5000 r/min.
梭尖半径取 13.5 mm（算例值），线速度约 14 m/s。
With a hook-point radius of 13.5 mm (worked-example value) the linear speed is about 14 m/s.
梭尖以这样的速度在离机针不到 0.1 mm 处掠过。
At this speed the hook point sweeps past the needle less than 0.1 mm away.
narration: 2:1 带来一个直接的结果：旋梭转得非常快。主轴 5000 转每分钟，旋梭就是一万转。梭尖所在的半径按算例取 13.5 毫米，代进公式，2π 乘半径再乘每秒转数，梭尖线速度大约 14 米每秒。大家想象一下这个画面：一个每秒走 14 米的钢尖，从一根直径不到一毫米的机针旁边掠过，两者之间的缝隙还不到 0.1 毫米。这就是为什么钩线这件事对位置和时刻那么敏感，也为什么旋梭的材料、热处理和润滑在后面第 8 章、第 23 章都要专门讲。

The 2:1 ratio has a direct consequence: the hook turns very fast. At 5000 r/min on the main shaft, the hook turns at ten thousand. Take the hook-point radius as 13.5 mm from the worked example and put it into the formula — 2π times the radius times revolutions per second — and the hook point moves at about 14 metres per second. Picture it: a steel point travelling fourteen metres a second sweeps past a needle less than a millimetre thick, with a gap of under 0.1 mm between them. That is why loop catching is so sensitive to position and timing, and why the hook’s material, heat treatment and lubrication come up again in Chapters 8 and 23.

title: 现场能调的三个量
The three field adjustments
points: 钩线时刻：梭尖到达机针中心线时机针的回升量（手册 1.6–2.5 mm，标准约 2 mm）。
Loop-catch timing: the needle rise when the hook point reaches the needle centreline (manual 1.6–2.5 mm, about 2 mm standard).
针杆高度：钩线时梭尖下缘高于针眼上沿（手册 1.0 mm）。
Needle-bar height: hook-point lower edge above the top of the eye at catch (manual 1.0 mm).
梭尖间隙：梭尖与机针凹口表面的距离（某说明书 0.04–0.1 mm）。
Clearance: distance between hook point and needle surface at the scarf (one manual: 0.04–0.1 mm).
narration: 对一台设计定型的平缝机，现场能调的只有三个量，看图 5-3。左边是对着机针凹口看：线环在凹口一侧鼓出来，梭尖沿虚线横着扫过来。第一个量是钩线时刻，用梭尖到达机针中心线时机针从最低点回升了多少毫米来表示，叫回升量。第二个量是针杆高度，要求钩线那一刻梭尖的下缘比针眼上沿高一点，手册给的是 1.0 毫米。右边是梭尖高度处的截面，第三个量是梭尖和机针表面的间隙，某说明书要求 0.04 到 0.1 毫米。下面三页逐个讲。

On a lockstitch machine whose design is fixed, only three quantities can be adjusted in the field — see Fig. 5-3. On the left we look straight at the needle scarf: the loop bulges out on the scarf side and the hook point sweeps across along the dashed line. The first quantity is loop-catch timing, expressed as how many millimetres the needle has risen from its lowest point when the hook point reaches the needle centreline — the needle rise. The second is needle-bar height: at the moment of catch the hook point’s lower edge must sit a little above the top of the eye; the manual says 1.0 mm. On the right is a section at hook-point height, showing the third quantity, the clearance between hook point and needle surface: one manual asks for 0.04 to 0.1 mm. The next three slides take them one by one.

title: 钩线时刻：回升量与主轴转角
Loop-catch timing: needle rise and shaft angle
points: 下止点附近回升量与越过下止点的角度 δ 的平方成正比。
Near bottom dead centre the rise is proportional to the square of δ, the angle past BDC.
Example r = 15.5 mm, λ = 0.282: a 2 mm rise gives δ ≈ 26°, catch at about 206° (206.1° exactly).
主轴只差 5°，回升量从 1.3 mm（201°）变到 2.8 mm（211°），超出手册全部范围。
Just 5° of shaft angle moves the rise from 1.3 mm (201°) to 2.8 mm (211°), beyond the whole manual range.
调法：松开旋梭固定螺钉转动旋梭；旋梭转 1°，相当于主轴 0.5°。
Adjust by loosening the hook set screws and turning the hook; 1° of hook equals 0.5° of shaft.
料越厚、线越粗，回升量取得越大。
The heavier the fabric and thread, the larger the rise.
narration: 先看钩线时刻。为什么用回升量而不用角度？因为下止点附近针杆曲线很平，第 3 章推过，回升量和越过下止点的角度 δ 的平方成正比。代入算例，回升 2 毫米对应 δ 约 26 度，钩线在 206 度左右，精确算是 206.1 度。毫米比角度直观，但是大家要注意它的灵敏度：主轴只差 5 度，回升量就从 1.3 毫米跳到 2.8 毫米，把手册的整个范围都跨过去了。现场调的时候松开旋梭在轴上的螺钉转旋梭，因为是 2:1，旋梭转 1 度，钩线时刻只动主轴半度。一般料越厚、线越粗，回升量取得越大。

First, loop-catch timing. Why use the rise rather than an angle? Because the needle-bar curve is flat near bottom dead centre: as Chapter 3 showed, the rise is proportional to the square of δ, the angle past BDC. In the worked example a 2 mm rise means δ is about 26°, so catch happens at about 206° — 206.1° by exact calculation. Millimetres are more intuitive than degrees, but notice the sensitivity: a difference of just 5° of shaft angle takes the rise from 1.3 mm to 2.8 mm, right across the manual’s whole range. In the field you loosen the hook’s set screws and turn the hook; because of the 2:1 ratio, turning the hook 1° moves the catch by only half a degree of shaft. Generally, the heavier the fabric and thread, the larger the rise.

title: 针杆高度
Needle-bar height
points: 钩线时梭尖下缘要高出针眼上沿，梭尖从针眼上方的线环里钻过，不划到针眼里的线。
At catch the hook-point lower edge must be above the eye, so it passes through the loop above the eye without cutting the thread in it.
调法：松开针杆连接轴，上下移动针杆；只改变针眼的绝对高度，不改变运动规律。
Adjust by loosening the needle-bar connecting stud and moving the bar; this changes only the eye’s absolute height, not the motion law.
有的说明书用针杆上的刻线：最低位对齐一条线定高度，升到另一条线定钩线时刻。
Some manuals use marks on the needle bar: one aligned at the lowest position sets the height, another sets the catch timing.
narration: 第二个量是针杆高度。钩线那一刻，梭尖的下缘要比针眼的上沿高一点，梭尖才能从针眼上方的线环里钻过去，而不会划到穿在针眼里的那段线。手册给的是高 1.0 毫米。调法是松开第 3 章讲过的针杆连接轴，把针杆上下移一移。请注意，它只改变针眼的绝对高度，不改变针杆怎么运动，所以回升量的规律不变。有的说明书干脆不写毫米，而是在针杆上刻两条线：针杆在最低位置时一条线对齐针杆下轴套的下端，定高度；针杆升到另一条线对齐时让梭尖对准机针中心，定钩线时刻。现场用起来非常方便。

The second quantity is needle-bar height. At the moment of catch, the hook point’s lower edge must be a little higher than the top of the eye, so that it passes through the loop above the eye without cutting the thread lying in the eye. The manual says 1.0 mm above. To adjust it, loosen the needle-bar connecting stud from Chapter 3 and slide the bar up or down. Note that this changes only the absolute height of the eye, not how the needle bar moves, so the rise law stays the same. Some manuals give no millimetres at all, but engrave two marks on the bar: at the lowest position one mark aligns with the lower end of the bushing to set the height; when the bar has risen to the other mark, the hook point is set to the needle centre to set the timing. It is very handy on the shop floor.

title: 梭尖间隙与换针号
Hook clearance and needle-size changes
points: 间隙：某说明书 0.04–0.1 mm（H、L 型 0.06–0.17 mm），某维修手册 0.1 mm；沿旋梭轴向移动旋梭调整。
Clearance: one manual 0.04–0.1 mm (H and L types 0.06–0.17 mm), a service manual 0.1 mm; adjusted by moving the hook axially.
护针轻触机针，防止机针被厚料推偏后撞上梭尖。
The needle guard touches the needle lightly so a deflected needle cannot hit the hook point.
换针号：表面移动半个直径差。Nm 90→Nm 110，0.08 mm 变成 −0.02 mm，撞针。
Needle change: the surface moves by half the diameter difference. Nm 90→Nm 110 turns 0.08 mm into −0.02 mm: a strike.
换细针间隙变大，容易跳针；换针号后一定重调间隙。
A finer needle opens the gap and invites skipped stitches; always re-set after changing size.
narration: 第三个量是梭尖和机针的间隙，靠沿旋梭轴向挪动旋梭来调，常见要求是 0.04 到 0.1 毫米。旋梭上还有个护针，轻轻贴着机针，缝厚料时机针被布推偏，它就挡住机针不让它撞上梭尖。这里有一条车间铁律：间隙是按某一号针调定的。针号 Nm 除以 100 大约就是针的直径毫米数。从 Nm 90 换到 Nm 110，直径大了 0.2 毫米，表面向梭尖靠近一半，就是 0.1 毫米，原来 0.08 的间隙变成负 0.02，梭尖直接撞针。反过来换细针，间隙变大，线环钩不住就跳针。所以换针号以后，一定要重调间隙。

The third quantity is the clearance between hook point and needle, adjusted by sliding the hook along its axis; a common requirement is 0.04 to 0.1 mm. The hook also carries a needle guard that rests lightly against the needle: when heavy fabric pushes the needle sideways, it stops the needle hitting the hook point. And here is an iron rule of the shop floor: the clearance is set for one particular needle size. The Nm number divided by 100 is roughly the needle diameter in millimetres. Going from Nm 90 to Nm 110 adds 0.2 mm of diameter, and the surface moves half of that, 0.1 mm, towards the hook point: a clearance of 0.08 becomes minus 0.02, and the hook point strikes the needle. Go to a finer needle and the gap opens, the loop is missed and stitches skip. So always re-set the clearance after changing needle size.

title: 钩线窗口：一个示意模型
The loop-catch window: an illustrative model
points: 线环鼓出距离先随回升量增大，约 2.2 mm 时最大，再减小；线环从针眼上沿向上延伸，中间鼓得最多。
The loop bulge grows with rise, peaks at about 2.2 mm, then shrinks; vertically it starts at the eye top and bulges most in the middle.
钩住条件：梭尖高度处线环离机针的距离 w 大于间隙 g 加梭尖厚 t_b（模型取 0.15 mm）。
Catch condition: loop distance w at hook height exceeds clearance g plus hook thickness t_b (0.15 mm in the model).
另有两条：梭尖下缘离针眼上沿小于 0.2 mm 会劈线；间隙小到零会撞针。
Plus two more: hook edge within 0.2 mm of the eye top splits thread; zero clearance strikes the needle.
在“旋梭安装角—针杆高度”平面逐点检查，就得到钩线窗口。
Checking point by point over the plane “hook angle – needle-bar height” gives the window.
narration: 三个量为什么要一起调？得知道钩线那一刻线环有多大、在哪儿。真实的线环受线的刚度、捻度、布对线的夹持等很多因素影响，很难精确算，所以教材用了一个示意模型。机针回升后线环在凹口一侧鼓出，鼓出的距离先变大，回升约 2.2 毫米时最大，然后又收拢。梭尖能钩住的条件，是在梭尖所在的高度上，线环离开机针表面的距离 w 要大于间隙 g 加上梭尖钻进去所需的厚度。另外梭尖太贴近针眼会劈线，间隙为零会撞针。把这几条在“安装角—针杆高度”平面上逐点检查一遍，就画出了下一页的钩线窗口。

Why must the three be adjusted together? We need to know how big the loop is at the moment of catch and where it lies. A real loop depends on thread stiffness, twist, how the fabric grips the thread and much more, and is hard to calculate, so the book uses an illustrative model. As the needle rises the loop bulges on the scarf side; the bulge first grows, is largest at a rise of about 2.2 mm, and then closes up again. The hook point catches the loop if, at the hook-point height, the loop’s distance w from the needle surface exceeds the clearance g plus the thickness the hook point needs to get in. In addition, a hook point too close to the eye splits the thread, and zero clearance hits the needle. Check these conditions point by point over the plane of hook angle and needle-bar height, and you get the loop-catch window on the next slide.

title: 读钩线窗口：斜、宽、针织更窄
Reading the window: slanted, finite, narrower for knits
points: 窗口是斜的：钩线推迟，针眼已升高，梭尖相对偏低，要降针杆；提前则要升针杆。
Slanted: late catch means the eye has risen and the hook is relatively low, so lower the bar; early catch, raise it.
所以调整顺序：先定钩线时刻，再定针杆高度，最后定间隙。
Hence the order: timing first, then needle-bar height, clearance last.
窗口有宽度：梭织约 −7° 到 +10°（安装角），回升约 1.5–2.8 mm，主轴只有八度多，5000 r/min 下不到 0.3 ms。
Finite width: for woven fabric about −7° to +10° hook angle, rise about 1.5–2.8 mm; just over 8° of shaft, under 0.3 ms at 5000 r/min.
针织物线环小而不稳，窗口明显变窄，所以更容易跳针。
Knit loops are small and unstable, so the window is clearly narrower and skips are more frequent.
narration: 看图 5-4，抓住三点。第一，窗口是斜的。钩线推迟，也就是往右走，梭尖到的时候针眼已经升得更高，梭尖相对针眼就低了，很快掉进紫色的“太贴近针眼”区，要补救就得把针杆降下来。所以旋梭定时和针杆高度不能各调各的，手册规定先定时刻、再定高度、最后定间隙，道理就在这儿。第二，窗口有宽度。梭织面料大约从负 7 度到正 10 度安装角，换成主轴转角只有八度多，5000 转下不到 0.3 毫秒；手册把标准点放在窗口中间，留出余量。第三，右边针织物的窗口明显变窄，这就是针织物容易跳针的原因。

Look at Fig. 5-4 and take away three points. First, the window is slanted. If catch is delayed — moving right — the eye has already risen further when the hook point arrives, so the hook is relatively low and soon enters the purple “too close to the eye” zone; to compensate you must lower the needle bar. So hook timing and needle-bar height cannot be adjusted independently, and that is why the manual says timing first, then height, then clearance. Second, the window has a width: for woven fabric about minus 7 to plus 10 degrees of hook angle, which is only a little over eight degrees of shaft, less than 0.3 ms at 5000 r/min. The manual puts the standard point in the middle to leave margin. Third, the knit window on the right is clearly narrower — that is why knits skip stitches more.

title: 钩住以后：绕梭、脱环与润滑
After the catch: round the case, cast-off, lubrication
points: 梭壳被定位钩挡住，线从定位钩与梭床之间的缝隙穿过；开梭器把梭床轻轻拨开让路。
The case is held by the positioning finger; thread passes through the gap between finger and holder, and an opener nudges the holder aside.
缝隙太小卡线、断线、起毛；太大梭壳晃动、噪声大、钩线位置不稳。
Too small a gap jams, breaks or frays the thread; too large lets the case rattle, adds noise and unsettles the catch position.
旋梭约 10000 r/min，需可靠润滑：油泵经旋梭轴供油，螺钉调油量。
At about 10 000 r/min the hook needs reliable oiling: a pump feeds oil through the hook shaft, metered by a screw.
油多弄脏布料，油少发热磨损；少油、无油旋梭见第 8、23 章。
Too much oil soils fabric, too little causes heat and wear; low-oil and oil-free hooks: Chapters 8 and 23.
narration: 钩住以后，旋梭要带着线环绕过梭壳。梭壳是被定位钩挡住不转的，线就得从定位钩和梭床之间的那条缝里钻过去。有的旋梭还有开梭器，线环经过时把梭床轻轻拨开一点让路。这条缝要合适：太小，线被卡住，断线、起毛、线迹不匀；太大，梭壳晃来晃去，有噪声，钩线位置也不稳定。另外别忘了，旋梭在梭床里每分钟转一万转，必须可靠润滑，一般由油泵经旋梭轴送油，螺钉调油量。油多了甩到布上，服装厂最怕；油少了旋梭发热、磨损。少油和无油旋梭，我们到第 8 章和第 23 章再展开。

Once the loop is caught, the hook must carry it round the bobbin case. The case is held still by the positioning finger, so the thread has to squeeze through the gap between the finger and the holder. Some hooks have an opener that nudges the holder aside a little as the loop passes. That gap must be right: too small and the thread jams, breaks, frays or the stitches go uneven; too large and the case rattles, makes noise and the catch position wanders. And don’t forget the hook turns ten thousand times a minute in its race, so it needs reliable lubrication — usually a pump sends oil through the hook shaft, metered by a screw. Too much oil gets flung onto the fabric, which garment factories dread; too little and the hook heats up and wears. Low-oil and oil-free hooks come later, in Chapters 8 and 23.

title: 模型的边界与现场要点
Limits of the model and shop-floor notes
points: 线环模型是示意的，不能预测某台机器的具体窗口；参数参照手册设定，与手册“大体一致”不是独立验证。
The loop model is illustrative and cannot predict a given machine’s window; its parameters were set from the manuals, so agreement is not independent validation.
可靠做法：按手册调到标准位置，再用实际面料、针线试缝微调；研究中可用高速摄像或统计跳针率。
Reliable practice: set to the manual’s standard, then test-sew with real fabric, needle and thread; in research, use high-speed video or skip-rate counts.
换针号必重调间隙；针织跳针先换圆头针、查装针，再把间隙调到下限，不要一味升降针杆。
Always re-set clearance after a needle change; for knit skips, first use a ball-point needle and check installation, then go to the lower clearance limit — don’t just keep moving the bar.
听到“嗒嗒”声先停机查梭尖和机针，毛刺用油石修磨或更换。
On hearing a clicking, stop and inspect hook point and needle; dress burrs with an oilstone or replace.
narration: 最后说说模型的边界。本讲的线环模型是示意的，鼓出距离怎么变、梭尖厚度取多少，都是为了把三个量的配合讲清楚而设的，不能拿来预测某台机器的窗口。还要坦白一点：模型参数本来就是参照手册范围定的，所以窗口和手册“大体一致”，有一部分是设定出来的，不算独立验证。真实的线环还会扭转，高速时受空气和惯性影响。所以现场的可靠做法仍是：按手册调到标准位置，再用实际的布、针、线试缝微调。几条现场要点请大家记住：换针号必须重调间隙；针织物跳针先换圆头针；听到嗒嗒声马上停机检查。

Finally, the limits of the model. The loop model in this lesson is illustrative: how the bulge varies and how thick the hook point is taken to be were chosen to make the interaction of the three quantities clear, and cannot predict the window of a particular machine. We should also be honest that the parameters were set with reference to the manuals, so the window’s “broad agreement” with the manuals is partly built in and is not independent validation. Real loops also twist and, at high speed, feel air and inertia. So the reliable practice is still: set the machine to the manual’s standard, then test-sew with the actual fabric, needle and thread and fine-tune. Remember the shop-floor notes: always re-set the clearance after changing needle size; for skips on knits, change to a ball-point needle first; and if you hear clicking, stop at once and inspect.

summary: 全回转旋梭连续单向旋转、没有换向冲击，所以工业平缝机普遍采用；它与主轴的转速比为 2:1，用一圈空转换来收线和送布的时间。
The full rotary hook turns continuously with no reversal impact, so industrial machines use it; its 2:1 ratio to the main shaft trades an idle turn for take-up and feed time.
梭尖线速度 v = 2πR_h n_h，主轴 5000 r/min 时约 14 m/s，在离机针不到 0.1 mm 处掠过。
Hook-point speed v = 2πR_h n_h is about 14 m/s at 5000 r/min, passing less than 0.1 mm from the needle.
现场可调三个量：钩线时刻（回升量，h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ²）、针杆高度、梭尖间隙；旋梭转 1° 相当于主轴 0.5°。
Three field adjustments: loop-catch timing (rise, h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ²), needle-bar height and clearance; 1° of hook equals 0.5° of shaft.
换针号时机针表面移动半个直径差，间隙必须重调。
A needle-size change moves the needle surface by half the diameter difference, so the clearance must be re-set.
钩线窗口是斜的、有宽度，针织物更窄：时刻与高度要联调，顺序为时刻 → 高度 → 间隙，工作点放在窗口中间。
The window is slanted and finite, and narrower for knits: timing and height must be adjusted together, in the order timing → height → clearance, with the working point in the middle.

title: 旋梭定时与针杆高度联调
Joint adjustment of hook timing and needle-bar height
goal: 理解钩线时刻、针杆高度、梭尖间隙三个量如何共同决定能否钩住线环。
Understand how loop-catch timing, needle-bar height and clearance jointly decide whether the loop is caught.
学会按“时刻 → 高度 → 间隙”的顺序把一台没调好的机器调回手册范围。
Learn to bring a badly adjusted machine back into the manual ranges in the order timing → height → clearance.
用试缝 30 针统计跳针、劈线、碰针，体会窗口余量的意义。
Use 30-stitch test sewing to count skips, split threads and strikes, and see what window margin means.
theory: 钩线时刻用回升量表示：钩线时主轴转角 = 206.1° + 旋梭安装角/2，回升量按第 3 章曲柄滑块公式计算；手册 1.6–2.5 mm。
Timing is expressed as rise: catch angle = 206.1° + hook angle/2, rise from the Chapter 3 slider-crank formula; manual 1.6–2.5 mm.
钩住条件：梭尖高度处线环离机针的距离大于间隙 + 梭尖厚 0.15 mm；钩线余量 = 线环距离 − 间隙 − 梭尖厚。
Catch condition: loop distance at hook height exceeds clearance + 0.15 mm hook thickness; margin = loop distance − clearance − thickness.
梭尖下缘离针眼上沿小于 0.2 mm 判为劈线；实际间隙不大于约 0.02 mm 判为碰针。
Hook edge less than 0.2 mm above the eye counts as splitting; actual clearance of about 0.02 mm or less counts as a strike.
实际间隙 = 设定间隙 − (针径 − 0.9)/2；针织物线环更小、波动更大。
Actual clearance = set clearance − (needle diameter − 0.9)/2; knit loops are smaller and vary more.
steps: 打开实验页，先按“暂停”，拖动主轴转角滑杆（170°–240°），在正视和俯视截面中观察线环鼓出、梭尖到达机针中心的过程。
Open the lab, press Pause and drag the shaft-angle slider (170°–240°); watch the loop bulge and the hook point reach the needle centre in the front view and the section.
按“恢复手册标准”，记录读数区的钩线主轴转角、回升量、梭尖高于针眼、实际间隙和钩线余量；按“试缝 30 针”记录结果。
Press “Reset to manual standard” and record the catch angle, rise, hook height above the eye, actual clearance and margin; press “Sew 30 test stitches” and record the result.
按“打乱”，读出三个读数哪些超出手册范围；先调“旋梭安装角”使回升量回到 1.6–2.5 mm。
Press “Scramble” and note which readings are out of range; first adjust the hook installation angle until the rise is back within 1.6–2.5 mm.
再调“针杆高度”使梭尖高于针眼 0.8–1.5 mm，最后调“梭尖与机针间隙”到 0.04–0.1 mm；试缝 30 针全部正常即完成任务 1。
Then adjust needle-bar height until the hook is 0.8–1.5 mm above the eye, and finally the clearance to 0.04–0.1 mm; 30 good test stitches completes Task 1.
在机针下拉框选 Nm 110，不动间隙先试缝一次，记录碰针数；再把间隙滑杆调大（相当于把旋梭向外移 0.1 mm），使读数中的实际间隙回到 0.04–0.1 mm，试缝全部正常（任务 2）。

Select Nm 110 in the needle list and test-sew without touching the clearance, noting the strikes; then increase the clearance slider (equivalent to moving the hook 0.1 mm outward) until the actual clearance reading is back in 0.04–0.1 mm and all stitches are good (Task 2).
面料改选“针织”，观察钩线窗口图变窄；把间隙调到下限附近，点击窗口图深绿区中间设定工作点，试缝 30 针全部正常（任务 3）。
Switch the fabric to Knit and watch the window shrink; set the clearance near the lower limit, click the middle of the dark-green zone to set the working point, and get 30 good stitches (Task 3).
面料改回梭织，把旋梭安装角设到 +10° 以上，试缝观察劈线；不再动旋梭，只降低针杆高度，使试缝 30 针全部正常（任务 4）。
Switch back to Woven, set the hook angle to +10° or more and test-sew to see split threads; without touching the hook, lower only the needle bar until 30 stitches are good (Task 4).
在窗口图上沿针杆高度为 0 的水平线点几处，记录能钩住的安装角范围，与教材的 −7° 到 +10° 比较。
Click several points along the zero needle-bar-height line of the window chart, record the range of hook angles that catch, and compare it with the book’s −7° to +10°.

caption: 钩线调整记录（每一行为一种设定）
Hook adjustment log (one row per setting)

questions: 为什么把旋梭推迟以后，只降低针杆就能恢复钩线？用窗口的斜率解释。
Why can lowering the needle bar alone restore loop catch after the hook is retarded? Explain with the slope of the window.
换 Nm 110 以后，你把设定间隙调到了多少？与 0.06 mm（Nm 90 时）之差是否等于半个直径差？
After fitting Nm 110, what clearance setting did you use? Is the difference from 0.06 mm (with Nm 90) equal to half the diameter difference?
针织面料上，余量大于 0.15 mm 的区域比梭织小多少？为什么要把工作点放在中间而不是刚好能钩住的边上？
On knit fabric, how much smaller is the zone with margin above 0.15 mm than on woven? Why put the working point in the middle rather than just inside the edge?

title: 钩线调整计算与诊断
Hook adjustment: calculation and diagnosis
tasks: （计算）算例机 r = 15.5 mm、λ = 0.282。用近似式 h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ² 求回升量为 1.6 mm、2.0 mm、2.5 mm 时的钩线主轴转角；若把钩线从 1.6 mm 调到 2.5 mm，旋梭在轴上要转过多少度？并说明主轴每差 1° 回升量大约变化多少、为什么用毫米表示钩线时刻更直观。

(Calculation) Worked-example machine r = 15.5 mm, λ = 0.282. Use h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ² to find the main-shaft angle of loop catch for rises of 1.6, 2.0 and 2.5 mm. If catch is changed from 1.6 mm to 2.5 mm, through how many degrees must the hook be turned on its shaft? State roughly how much the rise changes per degree of shaft angle and why millimetres are more intuitive for timing.
（计算与判断）某平缝机用 Nm 90 机针时间隙调为 0.06 mm。分别换成 Nm 70 和 Nm 110，间隙各变为多少？对照 0.04–0.1 mm 的范围，各会出现什么毛病？写出重调的方向和移动量。

(Calculation and judgement) A machine’s clearance was set to 0.06 mm with an Nm 90 needle. What does it become with Nm 70 and with Nm 110? Against the 0.04–0.1 mm range, what fault does each cause? Give the direction and amount of re-adjustment.
（实验）完成虚拟实验 5-1 的任务 4：旋梭安装角推迟到 +10° 以上，只调针杆高度使试缝 30 针全部正常。截图记录调整前后的读数，并用窗口的斜率说明为什么这样能补救。

(Lab) Complete Task 4 of Virtual lab 5-1: retard the hook angle to +10° or more and adjust only the needle-bar height until all 30 test stitches are good. Screenshot the readings before and after, and use the slope of the window to explain why this works.
（论述）一条 T 恤线跳针严重。列出至少三条减少跳针的措施，说明每一条是从钩线窗口的哪个方向（加宽窗口、把工作点移到中间、减小所需距离）改善了钩住的条件。

(Discussion) A T-shirt line skips stitches badly. List at least three measures to reduce skipping and explain, for each, in which way it improves the catch condition in the window (widening the window, centring the working point, reducing the distance needed).
deliverable: 一份 PDF：计算过程（含公式和代入）、实验截图与记录表、论述题答案，共 3–4 页。
One PDF: calculations (formulas and substitutions), lab screenshots and log table, and the discussion answer; 3–4 pages.
rubric: 第 1、2 题计算正确，单位和有效数字合理（40 分）
Tasks 1 and 2 calculated correctly with sensible units and figures (40 points)
第 2 题对毛病的判断和重调方向正确（15 分）
Task 2: correct diagnosis and adjustment direction (15 points)
实验截图完整，用窗口斜率的解释清楚（25 分）
Complete lab screenshots and a clear explanation using the window slope (25 points)
论述题措施具体、与窗口方向对应正确（20 分）
Discussion measures are concrete and correctly mapped to the window (20 points)

text: 工业平缝机普遍采用全回转旋梭，最主要的原因是：
The main reason industrial lockstitch machines use the full rotary hook is:
旋梭连续单向旋转，没有换向冲击，能跑很高的转速
It rotates continuously in one direction with no reversal impact, so it can run very fast
全回转旋梭的梭芯比摆梭大，能装更多底线
Its bobbin is larger than an oscillating shuttle’s and holds more thread
全回转旋梭不需要润滑
It needs no lubrication
全回转旋梭与主轴 1:1 同步，定时最简单
It runs 1:1 with the main shaft, which makes timing simplest

feedback: 摆梭每针换向两次、质量大；全回转旋梭连续单向转动，没有换向冲击，所以速度能提上去。它与主轴是 2:1，而且需要可靠润滑。
The oscillating shuttle is heavy and reverses twice a stitch; the full rotary hook turns continuously with no reversal impact, so it can go fast. It runs at 2:1 and does need reliable lubrication.

text: 全回转旋梭每针转两圈，其中只有一圈带着线环，另一圈是空转。
A full rotary hook turns twice per stitch; only one turn carries the loop, the other is idle.
feedback: 从钩线到脱环旋梭约转 270°，在 2:1 下只占主轴 135°；第二圈不带线，是用来换取收线时间的空转。
From catch to cast-off the hook turns about 270°, only 135° of shaft at 2:1; the second turn carries no thread and is the idle turn that buys take-up time.

text: 如果全回转旋梭改成与主轴 1:1（钩线仍在 206°，旋梭从钩线到脱环仍需转 270°），会出现什么问题？
If a full rotary hook ran 1:1 with the shaft (catch still at 206°, still 270° of hook rotation from catch to cast-off), what goes wrong?
线环要到 476°（下一针 116°）才脱出，而下一针在 102° 已经入布
The loop leaves only at 476° (116° of the next stitch), but the next needle has entered at 102°
梭尖速度翻倍，超过 28 m/s
The hook-point speed doubles to over 28 m/s
钩线时线环还没有张开，必然跳针
The loop is not yet open at catch, so it always skips
送布牙与旋梭相撞
The feed dog collides with the hook

feedback: 1:1 时 270° 旋梭转角要占主轴 270°，206° + 270° = 476°，下一针 102° 已经入布，上一针还没收紧。1:1 时梭尖速度反而减半。
At 1:1 the 270° of hook rotation takes 270° of shaft: 206° + 270° = 476°, while the next needle entered at 102°, so the previous stitch is not yet set. The hook speed would actually halve.

text: 主轴转速 4000 r/min，旋梭与主轴转速比 2:1，梭尖半径 13.5 mm。梭尖线速度是多少 m/s？
Main shaft at 4000 r/min, hook-to-shaft ratio 2:1, hook-point radius 13.5 mm. What is the linear speed of the hook point in m/s?
feedback: The hook turns at 8000 r/min: v = 2π × 0.0135 × 8000/60 ≈ 11.3 m/s. Forgetting the factor 2 gives 5.65 m/s.

text: 对一台设计定型的平缝机，修机师傅在现场调整钩线时能调的量有哪些？
On a lockstitch machine whose design is fixed, which quantities can a mechanic adjust in the field for loop catching?
钩线时刻（以机针回升量表示）
Loop-catch timing (expressed as needle rise)
针杆高度
Needle-bar height
梭尖与机针的间隙
Hook-to-needle clearance
旋梭与主轴的转速比
The hook-to-shaft speed ratio
针杆曲柄半径
The needle-bar crank radius

feedback: 现场只调三个量：钩线时刻（转动旋梭）、针杆高度（移动针杆）、间隙（轴向移动旋梭）。转速比和曲柄半径是设计决定的。
Only three are adjusted in the field: timing (turn the hook), needle-bar height (move the bar) and clearance (move the hook axially). The speed ratio and crank radius are fixed by design.

text: 算例机 r = 15.5 mm、λ = 0.282。用 h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ² 求机针回升 1.6 mm 时的钩线主轴转角（上止点为 0°）。
Worked-example machine r = 15.5 mm, λ = 0.282. Using h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ², find the main-shaft angle (0° = top dead centre) at which the needle has risen 1.6 mm.
feedback: (r/2)(1+λ) = 9.934 mm, δ = √(1.6/9.934) = 0.401 rad ≈ 23.0°, so catch is at 180° + 23.0° = 203.0°. δ is measured from bottom dead centre, so add 180°.

text: 用 Nm 80 机针时梭尖间隙调为 0.09 mm。换成 Nm 100 而不重调，间隙变为多少 mm？（负值表示干涉）
The clearance was set to 0.09 mm with an Nm 80 needle. After changing to Nm 100 without re-setting, what is the clearance in mm? (Negative means interference.)
feedback: 直径从 0.8 mm 增到 1.0 mm，表面向梭尖靠近 0.1 mm，0.09 − 0.10 = −0.01 mm，梭尖碰针。常见错误是把整个直径差 0.2 mm 都减掉。
Diameter goes from 0.8 to 1.0 mm; the surface moves 0.1 mm towards the hook: 0.09 − 0.10 = −0.01 mm, a strike. A common mistake is subtracting the whole 0.2 mm diameter difference.

text: 钩线时刻推迟了，针杆高度没动，按钩线窗口模型最可能出现的问题是：
If loop-catch timing has become late and the needle-bar height is unchanged, the most likely fault according to the window model is:
梭尖相对针眼偏低，太贴近针眼，容易劈线、断线
The hook point is relatively low and too close to the eye, so the thread splits or breaks
线环还没鼓出来，梭尖从线环外面滑过
The loop has not bulged yet and the hook point slips past outside it
梭尖与机针间隙变为零，碰针
The clearance drops to zero and the hook strikes the needle
底线被拉到布面
The bobbin thread is pulled to the top of the fabric

feedback: 推迟时针眼已经升得更高，梭尖相对针眼变低，进入“太贴近针眼”区；补救是降低针杆。线环没鼓出是钩线太早的情形；间隙与定时无关。

When catch is late the eye has risen further, so the hook is relatively lower and enters the “too close to the eye” zone; the remedy is to lower the needle bar. An unopened loop is the early-catch case; clearance is unrelated to timing.

text: 针织物弹性大、线环大，所以它的钩线窗口比梭织面料更宽。
Knit fabric is elastic and forms a large loop, so its loop-catch window is wider than woven fabric’s.
feedback: 恰恰相反：针织物对线的夹持差，线环小而且不稳定，窗口更窄，所以针织物更容易跳针。
The opposite: knit fabric grips the thread poorly, so the loop is small and unstable, the window is narrower and knits skip more.

text: 维修手册规定的钩线调整顺序通常是：
The adjustment order usually prescribed by service manuals is:
先定钩线时刻，再定针杆高度，最后调间隙
Timing first, then needle-bar height, clearance last
先调间隙，再定钩线时刻，最后定针杆高度
Clearance first, then timing, needle-bar height last
先定针杆高度，再调间隙，最后定钩线时刻
Needle-bar height first, then clearance, timing last
三个量互不影响，顺序无所谓
The three are independent, so order does not matter

feedback: 窗口是斜的：时刻一变，梭尖相对针眼的高度就变，所以先定时刻、再按时刻定高度；间隙与两者基本独立，最后调并复查。

The window is slanted: changing the timing changes the hook’s height relative to the eye, so fix timing first, then height to suit; clearance is largely independent and comes last, followed by a check.

text: 算例机 r = 15.5 mm、λ = 0.282。用 h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ² 计算：把钩线从回升 1.6 mm 调到 2.2 mm，旋梭在旋梭轴上要转过多少度？
Worked-example machine r = 15.5 mm, λ = 0.282. Using h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ², if loop catch is changed from a rise of 1.6 mm to 2.2 mm, through how many degrees must the hook be turned on its shaft?
feedback: 1.6 mm 对应 203.0°，2.2 mm 对应 207.0°，主轴差约 3.97°；旋梭转速是主轴两倍，要转约 7.9°。只算主轴角会少一半。
1.6 mm gives 203.0°, 2.2 mm gives 207.0°, a shaft difference of about 3.97°; the hook turns twice as fast, so about 7.9°. Giving only the shaft angle halves the answer.

text: 某机型的钩线窗口约为主轴转角 10°。主轴转速 4500 r/min 时，这个窗口持续多少毫秒？
A machine’s loop-catch window is about 10° of main-shaft angle. At 4500 r/min, how many milliseconds does it last?
feedback: 4500 r/min = 27000°/s，10° ÷ 27000°/s = 0.370 ms。窗口以毫秒计，所以靠刚性机械传动锁定相位。
4500 r/min = 27 000°/s; 10° ÷ 27 000°/s = 0.370 ms. A window this short is why the phase is locked by a rigid mechanical drive.

text: 缝针织 T 恤跳针严重，下列哪些措施符合教材的建议？
A knit T-shirt line skips stitches badly. Which measures agree with the book’s advice?
换用圆头针，并检查机针是否装正
Use ball-point needles and check that the needle is installed straight
把梭尖间隙调到下限
Set the hook clearance to the lower limit
把工作点放在钩线窗口中间
Place the working point in the middle of the window
把梭尖间隙调大，避免碰针
Increase the clearance to avoid needle strikes
一味抬高或降低针杆，直到不跳为止
Keep raising or lowering the needle bar until skipping stops

feedback: 针织物线环小，要减小所需的距离（间隙调到下限）、把工作点放在中间，并先排除针的问题；加大间隙会更跳针，盲目调针杆会掉进劈线区。

Knit loops are small, so reduce the distance needed (lower clearance), centre the working point and rule out needle problems first; a larger clearance skips more, and blindly moving the bar can enter the splitting zone.

text: 手册把标准位置放在钩线窗口的中间（而不是靠近边界），主要目的是：
The manual puts the standard position in the middle of the loop-catch window rather than near an edge mainly in order to:
留出余量，吸收线环大小波动、机针摆动和零件磨损
Leave margin to absorb variations in loop size, needle deflection and wear
使梭尖速度最低，减少发热
Minimise hook-point speed and heating
让旋梭第二圈也能钩线
Let the hook catch on its second turn as well
减少挑线杆的放线量
Reduce the thread released by the take-up lever

feedback: 实际每一针的线环、机针位置和间隙都有波动，工作点放在中间才能让这些波动不把它推出窗口。试缝 30 针的统计正是体现这一点。
Every stitch varies in loop size, needle position and clearance; only a centred working point keeps these variations inside the window, as the 30-stitch trial shows.

text: 教材的示意钩线窗口与维修手册的范围大体一致，这证明线环模型能够独立预测真实机器的钩线窗口。
The book’s illustrative window broadly agrees with the service-manual ranges, which proves that the loop model can independently predict a real machine’s window.
feedback: 模型参数本来就是参照手册范围设定的，一致性有一部分是设定出来的，不是独立验证；真实窗口要靠试缝统计或高速摄像。
The model parameters were set from the manual ranges, so the agreement is partly built in, not independent validation; real windows need test-sewing statistics or high-speed video.

key: 2:1 转速比的道理；钩线三个可调量及其测量方法；换针号后间隙的计算。
The reason for the 2:1 ratio; the three adjustable quantities and how they are measured; clearance change after a needle change.
difficult: 钩线窗口为什么是斜的、为什么时刻与针杆高度必须联调；回升量与主轴转角之间的平方关系带来的灵敏度。
Why the window is slanted and why timing and needle-bar height must be adjusted together; the sensitivity caused by the square-law relation between rise and shaft angle.

content: 展示跳针、碰针的线迹与断针照片，提出“换粗针后嗒嗒响”的问题，学生先猜原因。
Show skipped-stitch and needle-strike samples and a broken needle; pose the “clicking after a thicker needle” problem and let students guess the cause.
钩线四项任务；三种钩线器；用图 5-2 推出 2:1，算梭尖速度。播放动画 2-1 看钩线、绕梭、脱环。
Four tasks; three devices; derive 2:1 from Fig. 5-2 and compute hook speed. Play Animation 2-1 for catch, passing the case and cast-off.

phase: 讲授与练习：三个可调量
Lecture and practice: the three adjustments
content: 回升量公式与换算练习；针杆高度；间隙与换针号计算。学生当堂计算导入问题的前半部分。
Rise formula and conversion exercises; needle-bar height; clearance and needle-size calculations. Students solve the first half of the opening problem in class.
线环示意模型、钩住条件；读图 5-4 的三个要点；模型的边界。
Illustrative loop model and catch condition; three points of Fig. 5-4; limits of the model.
分组完成四个任务，填写记录表；教师巡视，重点看是否按时刻 → 高度 → 间隙的顺序调。
Groups complete the four tasks and fill in the log; the teacher checks that they follow timing → height → clearance.
回到导入问题，给出完整解答；讲评实验思考题；布置作业。
Return to the opening problem and give the full answer; discuss the lab questions; set the assignment.

homework: 完成作业“钩线调整计算与诊断”；预习第 6 章送布机构，思考布在什么时候才能移动。
Complete the assignment “Hook adjustment: calculation and diagnosis”; preview Chapter 6 on the feed mechanism and think about when the fabric may move.
